title: Payment-Effort Points in Insulin Pump Program Hardship Scoring
content:
**What are payment-effort points on an Insulin Pump Program hardship waiver?**
Points added to the share of the waiver according to the program's customer payments:

- where a payment posted in the three months before today and another in the three months before those, 10 points (the full effort points) are added to the share;
- where a payment posted in the six months before today but not in both of those three-month spans, 5 points (the partial effort points) are added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

**Which payments count, and when is a payment "in the three months"?**
Customer payments posted on the pump program. A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window.

**A customer paid two months ago and again five months ago. How many points?**
A payment in each of the two three-month spans: 10 points.

**A customer paid twice in the last month and not before?**
Payments in the six months but not in both spans: 5 points.

**No payment in six months?**
Nothing is added.
